objective: Substantial independently confirmed localization improvement over a reliable same-model comparator, not merely functionality or context preservation.
current_evidence: R5 audited exposed score: ARE12/16 versus baseline13/16 Hit@1;31/32 valid. R6 remains live with no evaluator labels. Confirmed navigation activates in completed Closure and Collections index episodes; real state fits338/406 tokens, proved by separately frozen serialized-domain audit repair. Activation is not evidence of ranking advantage.

primary_sources.title: A Quantitative and Qualitative Evaluation of LLM-Based Explainable Fault Localization
primary_sources.finding: AutoFL separates evidence navigation/root-cause explanation from final localization and aggregates repeated predictions. Tool retrieval and exact candidate identity are important; repetitions are additional opportunities, not free confidence.
primary_sources.transfer: Use acquisition-to-selection discipline without copying answer examples, postprocessing invalid outputs, adding repetitions or claiming AutoFL reproduction.

primary_sources.title: A Multi-Agent Approach to Fault Localization via Graph-Based Retrieval and Reflexion
primary_sources.inspection: Sections3.1-3.3; exactv2 title/version differs from initial search abstract
primary_sources.finding: LLM4FL combines failure-context prioritization, graph-assisted source inspection and review that may retrieve further implementation evidence. Coverage ordering and dependencies are distinct ingredients.
primary_sources.transfer: Seek additional distinguishing source evidence rather than generic self-review. Our syntactic unresolved references are not typed call graphs; aggregate positive runtime metadata cannot support Ochiai without per-test passing/failing spectra. No multi-agent calls launched.

primary_sources.title: FlexFL: Flexible and Effective Fault Localization with Open-Source Large Language Models
primary_sources.finding: FlexFL uses broad candidate search followed by source double-checking, indexed candidate identities and flexible early exit. Its name postprocessing and candidate filtering are separate design choices.
primary_sources.transfer: Borrow evidence checking, not silent fuzzy-ID correction or hard candidate-universe reduction. Preserve all production eligibility and strict actual-request terminal aliases. Forced redundant iterations may distract and waste budget.

primary_sources.title: Large Language Models Cannot Self-Correct Reasoning Yet
primary_sources.finding: Studied models/tasks can fail or worsen when revising answers without external feedback. This is not a universal theorem about current GLM or source-grounded debugging.
primary_sources.transfer: Generic critic text is not an accuracy oracle. Prioritize tool-grounded counterevidence and evaluate both improvements and reversals of correct answers.

primary_sources.title: Fault Localization from the Semantic Code Search Perspective
primary_sources.inspection: Authors' abstract; publisher endpoint was unavailable
primary_sources.finding: CosFL formulates faulty functionality as a semantic query and uses multi-granularity retrieval.
primary_sources.transfer: A promising later retrieval candidate, but embedding/index/model costs and same-evidence parity need their own scope. Do not claim its reported scores for ARE or retrofit a new retriever into frozen r6.

selected_next_candidate.name: Evidence-grounded counterexample acquisition policy
selected_next_candidate.hypothesis: A generic ARE guidance policy that distinguishes failure symptoms from a proposed cause and encourages targeted source checks of alternative explanations can improve localization before context recycling, where memory-only retention may not activate.
selected_next_candidate.policy_shape: Public, versioned, task-independent guidance; identify expected-versus-observed behavior from existing failure input, prefer source inspections capable of distinguishing plausible explanations, and verify delivered source supports the final ranking. No emitted hidden reasoning or free-form rationale requirement; terminal remains context_handles only.
selected_next_candidate.activation: Prospective treatment guidance can activate from the initial request, not only after a recycle. Preserve the same actual task/failure query, common tools/source access, corrected baseline terminal, budgets and reserves. Guidance overhead counts against actual8K and generation cost.
constraints: No case-specific gold or paths from scored mistakes embedded in policy
No automatic extra critic/generation/tool calls or mandatory fixed number of reads

No new retriever, external dependency, hidden reasoning access or historic fix data
